name: Disarming Colloid
summary: At the Stonewrought Dam, Disarming Colloid may keep Seaforium from exploding when wet. Ashlan Stonesmirk provides it in the Wetlands to neutralize the powder.

sections.title: A Chemical Neutralizer
sections.body:
At Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan, Ashlan Stonesmirk recognizes the powder left by Dark Iron sappers as Seaforium. Its scent and fine silver crystals give it away. Dry, the powder is harmless. Moisture makes it immensely destructive, a grave danger at the waterlogged dam.

Stonesmirk provides Disarming Colloid to stop the reaction before detonation. Mixed with lurker venom, crushed Mo'grosh crystal, and a crocolisk tear, the colloid neutralizes Seaforium's explosive properties.

faq.q: What is Disarming Colloid used for?
faq.answer: Disarming Colloid helps defuse Seaforium. Mixed with lurker venom, crushed Mo'grosh crystal, and a crocolisk tear, it neutralizes the powder's volatile reaction when wet.

faq.q: Who created or provided this colloid?
faq.answer: Ashlan Stonesmirk provides the colloid. He is an explosives expert assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr in the Wetlands. He recognizes the Dark Iron dwarves' plan to destroy the Stonewrought Dam.

faq.q: Why is Seaforium so dangerous in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: Dry, Seaforium is harmless, but moisture makes it violently explosive. The Wetlands are saturated with water, and the powder is aimed at the Stonewrought Dam. Damp Seaforium threatens massive devastation.

faq.q: Who must this colloid be delivered to?
aliases: who do i take colloid to
faq.answer: Ashlan Stonesmirk says the colloid and news of the Seaforium plot must go straight to Chief Engineer Hinderweir at the Stonewrought Dam.

angles.text: As an engineer, you know Seaforium can bring immense destruction. A precise chemical counteragent like this colloid can stop it.
As a dwarf, you know the Seaforium aimed at the Stonewrought Dam threatens dwarven engineering and the security of Loch Modan above.
